meta.employee_filter_semantics: Parent tasks assigned to the employee or containing their assigned subtasks; employee workload counts each actual assignment separately.
limitations: Multi-assignee work uses separate persisted task records; task groups are reported separately.
Inventory is current state filtered by task creation date, not historical state at that date.
Assignment dates are the latest stored assignment; complete reassignment history is unavailable.
